page_summary: This page discusses the concept of Cyber Resilient Ports, highlighting the differences between vulnerable ports and cyber resilient ports. It outlines the barriers to achieving cyber resilience and suggests ways forward, including strengthening policy, improving practices, and overcoming barriers. The visual representation contrasts a vulnerable port with a cyber resilient port, emphasizing the importance of governance, operational efficiency, and security.

regions.label: Vulnerable Port
regions.description: Illustration of a vulnerable port with high risk and low readiness, showing weak cyber governance, fragmented systems, and operational delays.

regions.label: Cyber Resilient Port
regions.description: Illustration of a cyber resilient port that is secure, efficient, and connected, featuring clear governance and reliable operations.

regions.label: The Way Forward to Cyber Resilient Ports
regions.description: Text outlining strategies to strengthen policy, improve practice, and overcome barriers for achieving cyber resilience in ports.
